items.title: Yankees' Bednar, Twins' Jeffers accept $23.15M qualifying offer to return
items.summary: Yankees closer David Bednar and Twins catcher Ryan Jeffers accepted the qualifying offer, returning to their respective teams on a one-year deal worth $23.15M.

items.title: Pitching-needy White Sox, May agree to 3-year, $52.5M contract
items.summary: The White Sox and free agent starting pitcher Dustin May have agreed on a 3-year, $52.5M contract. The right-hander went 7-9 with a 4.70 ERA last season.

items.title: Bauers: City of Boston figured into decision to sign with Red Sox
items.summary: Jake Bauers said he's grateful for the chance to play in a city that he and his wife, Lauren, had always circled on the schedule during his major league career.

items.title: Hitters benefited from checked-swing reviews in minor league testing
items.summary: The introduction of robot umpire appeals for checked-swing calls in the Triple-A Pacific Coast League this year led to lower swing-and-miss rates on breaking and off-speed pitches.

items.title: Posey, Lester among 14 newcomers on baseball's Hall of Fame ballot
items.summary: Buster Posey and Jon Lester are among 14 newcomers on baseball's Hall of Fame ballot, while former players Chase Utley and Andy Pettitte are among the 13 holdover candidates.

items.title: D-backs' Lawlar expected to be ready for regular season after elbow surgery
items.summary: Diamondbacks outfielder Jordan Lawlar had internal brace surgery on his right elbow earlier in the offseason and is expected to be ready around the scheduled start of the regular season.

items.title: Sources: Reliever Hill, Yankees agree to $2.25M contract
items.summary: Left-hander Tim Hill is staying with the Yankees, agreeing to a one-year, $2.25 million contract, sources told ESPN.
